title: B2B SEO Locked Project Profile Schema
description: Canonical project-profile.json contract produced by /profile-lock and consumed by QA and publish stages.

hostBlogEngine.description: Target blog rendering stack, e.g., 'wordpress-livecanvas-windpress-arch-dark-gold', 'wordpress-shortcodes', or 'mdx-astro'.

proseMeasureCh.description: Max prose column width in ch units (e.g., 68ch on #md-blog-single).

allowedMaterials.description: Strict whitelist of materials the brand actually manufactures (e.g., ['Stainless Steel 304', 'Stainless Steel 316']).

forbiddenTerms.description: Customer-facing vocabulary words forbidden by the project glossary (e.g., ['product', 'products', 'order', 'cart'] when 'pattern' and 'inquiry' are mandated).

preferredTerms.description: Mapping of forbidden/discouraged term -> canonical glossary term (e.g., {'product': 'pattern', 'order': 'inquiry'}).
